children: Alramz Real Estate Company has secured Shariah-compliant credit facilities of 500 million Saudi riyals ($133.28 million) to finance real estate acquisition and development.
The credit line was obtained from Al Rajhi Bank, the developer said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
The facilities are divided into two tranches. The first is SAR 450 million with a five-year tenor, while the second is SAR 50 million with a three-month tenor.
The loan will also support expansion plans of Alramz's real estate projects and finance its general working capital requirements.
The guarantees include a mortgage in favor of the bank, a promissory note payable on demand and Shariah-compliant takaful insurance covering the mortgaged assets.

title: Saudi-listed Alramz secures $133mln loan to fund real estate development
